summary: Frontend-only test of Phase 1 account + seller + admin confirm features on Expo web (375x667). PASS: Akun menu (all 5 Akun Saya items, verify-reminder, Toko Saya/Buka Toko, logout confirm-dialog cancel), forgot password (step 2 + wrong-code forgot-error, tested with delivered@resend.dev), profile name/gender save + phone OTP test-mode (phone-dev-code -> Terverifikasi), register + change password (new pw works, old 401, session kept), addresses add/default/delete with confirm, checkout co-addr chips fill fields + co-addr-manage, notifications tabs/read-all + home notif-bell badge, activity (recently viewed + logs), settings toggles persist after reload, seller acct1 Toko Satu active + add-product sp-error without photo + product list row, throwaway user open-store -> 'Menunggu verifikasi admin', admin stores filters + approve with confirm, banner/voucher delete confirm-dialog (cancelled), product card 'PGS Official' + pd-store-link -> /shop/pgs-official. FAIL/BUGS: profile form empty on direct load/reload (HIGH); duplicate products in paginated lists (FIXED by me); guest on /account/* sees raw 'Not authenticated'. No deprecated packages (expo-av/barcode-scanner/background-fetch) detected.

minor.issue: Unstable sort (no unique tiebreaker) caused overlapping pages with skip pagination -> 'Encountered two children with the same key' on shop page. FIXED: added product_id tiebreaker in server.py sort_map; verified 0 duplicates across 3 pages.
Some products have stock=0 but in_stock=true (e.g. pgs-9957) -> card shows '0 stok tersedia' and sorts first in 'popular'.
demo@pgs.id returns 'Alamat email ini tidak bisa menerima pesan' (email provider 422 for fake domain). Expected; not a bug.

ui_bugs.issue: When /account/profile is opened via direct URL / browser reload, name, gender, birthdate and phone inputs are EMPTY because useState initial values are taken from `user` while auth is still loading (profile.tsx:26-31). Pressing Simpan would blank the profile. Fix: sync state in useEffect when user loads or render form only after auth loading=false.
No auth guard: guest opening /account/addresses sees raw English 'Not authenticated' error instead of redirect to /login.

onEndReached fired before initial load / concurrently -> duplicated items. FIXED by me (guard !items.length + dedupe by product_id). Same pattern exists in (tabs)/kategori.tsx:44 and category/[id].tsx:48 (no dedupe).
router.back() without canGoBack fallback/success message: when opened by deep link, page stays after successful change with no feedback.
addr-default onPress has no try/catch -> unhandled rejection and no error shown on failure.

issues: 'Tandai dibaca' (notif-read-all) text is cut off at right edge at 375px width (tabs row overflow).
Password placeholder says 'Password (min. 6)' but validation requires 8 (register.tsx:67).
Saved-address chips show only label (two 'Rumah' chips are indistinguishable); show recipient/city too.
Switch element is 40x20px; ensure whole row is pressable for 44pt touch target.

action_items: HIGH: Fix profile.tsx initial state when user loads after mount (useEffect sync or gate on auth loading).
Add auth guard/redirect to /login for /account/*, /notifications, /seller when user is null.
Apply the same dedupe/guard to loadMore in (tabs)/kategori.tsx and category/[id].tsx.
password.tsx: use router.canGoBack() ? back() : replace('/(tabs)/akun') and show success.
Fix register placeholder to 'min. 8'; fix notif-read-all overflow; improve checkout address chip labels; wrap addr-default in try/catch.
Data: reconcile in_stock with stock=0 products.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py sort_map lacked unique tiebreakers -> skip pagination unstable (fixed).
profile.tsx derives form state from async-loaded context only at mount.

success_rate.frontend: ~92% (all 12 requested flows work; 1 HIGH reload bug + minor issues)

Seller product sp_8d0f2d52ec created for acct1 and deleted. U1 addresses + cart deleted. 1 password-reset request sent for delivered@resend.dev (not completed). Seeded banners/vouchers untouched (3 banners remain). demo/admin/acct1 passwords unchanged.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login via UI is reliable; injecting pgs_auth_token into localStorage before reload did NOT work in one attempt (API 401). In expo-router web, previous screens stay in DOM so testID counts can include hidden screens (e.g. notif-bell). FlatList scroll needs JS scrollTop on inner div, mouse.wheel doesn't trigger loadMore.
rca_of_issue: Duplicate keys on /shop/pgs-official: (1) Mongo sort on non-unique fields (in_stock, sold, updated_at) without tiebreaker gives non-deterministic order across skip pages; (2) FlatList onEndReached ran loadMore with items.length=0 concurrently with initial fetch. Both fixed and verified: 106 unique cards after scrolling, 0 duplicate-key errors.
